items.description: Laptop accidental damage repair (screen and lower-right corner), combined line paid direct to shop
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.1/2.6.2 (swerve in a conveyance) and 2.6.3 (all areas of damage on one unit are one loss); a combined line and direct settlement do not alter cover under 7.1.12. Priced at the reference level for screen plus corner repair (about 808 + 342), capped by replacement value under 7.1.10; no deductible is stated.
